# TokenAAS Examples Support

Choose the channel that matches your question:

- **How do I use an example?** Ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tokenaas/tokenaas-examples/discussions).
- **The example is broken or its README is wrong.** Open an issue using the example bug form.
- **I want a new SDK or framework example.** Open an example request.
- **Which models and prices are available?** Visit the [Model Plaza](https://tokenaas.ai/model-plaza).
- **Account, balance, payment, or business questions.** Email [admin@tokenaas.ai](mailto:admin@tokenaas.ai).
- **Security vulnerabilities.** Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and report privately.

Include the example path, exact model ID, runtime and SDK versions, sanitized error output, and TokenAAS request ID when available. Never include your API key.
